description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack right after Basic Attack Stage 1 to continuously attack the targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast Heavy Attack Stage 1.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage 1 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack Stage 1 to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after this skill lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding

When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding.
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Single Threading

When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading.
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Dual Threading

When in Algorithm Compaction and Root Access reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Single Threading is replaced with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading.
Consume STA and all Root Access to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Multi-threading

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target. SQL can be consumed for a 270% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction

When in Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction

When in Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 3.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tahan Normal Attack tepat setelah Basic Attack Tahap 1 untuk terus menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG. Tahan skill ini selama waktu tertentu untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Tahap 1.
Tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Basic Attack Tahap 3 mengenai target untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Tahap 2.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menghantam musuh dengan Monowire, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tahan Normal Attack setelah Heavy Attack Tahap 1 mengenai target untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Tahap 2, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack Tahap 1 untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 4.
Tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah skill ini mengenai target untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Tahap 2.

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding

Saat dalam Algorithm Compaction, Basic Attack Lucy diganti dengan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding.
Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Single Threading

Saat dalam Algorithm Compaction, Heavy Attack Lucy diganti dengan Heavy Attack - Single Threading.
Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini saat di udara untuk melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini saat di darat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Tahap 2.

Heavy Attack - Dual Threading

Saat dalam Algorithm Compaction dan Root Access mencapai 100 poin, Heavy Attack - Single Threading diganti dengan Heavy Attack - Dual Threading.
Mengonsumsi STA dan seluruh Root Access untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini saat di udara untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini saat di darat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Tahap 2.

Heavy Attack - Multi-threading

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG dan memberikan Hack - Shifting pada target. SQL dapat dikonsumsi untuk meningkatkan pengali DMG serangan ini sebesar 270%.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Tahap 2.

Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction

Saat dalam Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack diganti dengan Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction

Saat dalam Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter diganti dengan Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Tahap 3.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Payload

Cast Resonance Skill - Payload to charge forward, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing Spectro DMG and activating Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by 70%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
Press Normal Attack shortly after the follow-up attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference

Cast Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference to cut through the target, dealing Spectro DMG and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting Digital Handshake.
Digital Handshake: When Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains TCP every second. This effect is removed when TCP reaches 100 points or when Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is cast.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Deadlock

When TCP reaches 100 points or Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Cast Resonance Skill - Deadlock to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
Reset the CD of Resonance Skill - Deadlock after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Payload

Lancarkan Resonance Skill - Payload untuk menerjang ke depan, memberikan Spectro DMG dan memberikan Hack - Shifting. Saat mengenai target, serangan lanjutan otomatis terpicu, memberikan Spectro DMG dan mengaktifkan Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. Jika tidak ada target yang terkena selama terjangan, CD skill berkurang 70%. Jika terjangan terinterupsi atau tidak berhasil dilancarkan, CD skill tidak berkurang.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah serangan lanjutan untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah serangan lanjutan mengenai target untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Tahap 2.

Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference

Lancarkan Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference untuk menebas target, memberikan Spectro DMG dan menghentikan target sesaat dengan Stagnate, sebelum memberikan Digital Handshake.
Digital Handshake: Saat Lucy tidak dalam Algorithm Compaction dan menjadi Resonator aktif dalam tim, ia mendapat TCP setiap detik. Efek ini dihapus saat TCP mencapai 100 poin atau saat Resonance Liberation - Netrunner atau Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive dilancarkan.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Resonance Skill - Deadlock

Saat TCP mencapai 100 poin atau Lucy dalam Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Skill - Payload dan Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference diganti dengan Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Lancarkan Resonance Skill - Deadlock untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG dan memberikan Hack - Shifting, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Tahap 2.
Reset CD Resonance Skill - Deadlock setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Netrunner atau Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.

description.en:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner

Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for 10s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to 7 different Spoofing Program effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with 24 points of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all Spoofing Program effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no Spoofing Program can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when Normal Attack is held down, Override is triggered, which deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any Spoofing Programs, press Normal Attack to trigger Override on all marked targets.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Spoofing Program: Ping
Requires 2 RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals Spectro DMG to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout
Requires 5 RAM. Deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement
Requires 6 RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch
Requires 5 RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by 100% within 30s.
Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis
Requires 6 RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive

When in Algorithm Compaction, after Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is cast, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive. Lucy gains all effects of Resonance Liberation - Netrunner, and the DMG Multiplier of Override is greatly increased.
After casting Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or when Lucy exits the Algorithm Compaction state, Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Netrunner.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
description.id:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner

Lucy menyelam ke dunia maya dan memunculkan Protocol Interface selama 10 dtk. Selama Protocol Interface aktif, pilih hingga 7 efek Spoofing Program yang berbeda, masing-masing membutuhkan biaya RAM yang berbeda. Lucy memulai dengan 24 poin RAM.
Selama dalam Protocol Interface, Lucy menandai target dalam jangkauan tertentu di pandangannya. Target yang ditandai akan dikenai seluruh efek Spoofing Program yang dipilih setelahnya. Atur pandangan Lucy untuk menandai lebih banyak target. Saat tidak ada target dalam pandangan, tidak ada Spoofing Program yang dapat diterapkan.
Selama dalam Protocol Interface, saat durasi habis atau saat Normal Attack ditahan, Override terpicu, memberikan Spectro DMG kepada seluruh target yang ditandai sebelum menutup Protocol Interface, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG. Saat RAM habis atau tidak cukup untuk mengaktifkan Spoofing Program apa pun, tekan Normal Attack untuk memicu Override pada seluruh target yang ditandai.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.

Spoofing Program: Ping
Membutuhkan 2 RAM. Memperluas bidang pandang. Lucy menandai dan memberikan Spectro DMG kepada seluruh target di sekitar dalam jangkauan efektif tanpa perlu mengatur pandangan, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction
Membutuhkan 4 RAM. Target yang ditandai menerima 5% DMG lebih banyak selama 30 dtk.
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol
Membutuhkan 4 RAM. DEF target yang ditandai berkurang 5% selama 30 dtk.
Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout
Membutuhkan 5 RAM. Memberikan Spectro DMG kepada seluruh target yang ditandai dalam jangkauan tertentu, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement
Membutuhkan 6 RAM. Memberikan Hack DMG kepada seluruh target yang ditandai dan mengurangi ATK mereka sebesar 5% selama 30 dtk.
Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch
Membutuhkan 5 RAM. Membuat serangan seluruh target yang ditandai berpeluang berkurang 100% dalam 30 dtk.
Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis
Membutuhkan 6 RAM. Mengubah seluruh target yang ditandai menjadi unit netral dan mengurangi Vibration Strength mereka. Hanya efektif terhadap musuh Common Class.

Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive

Saat dalam Algorithm Compaction, setelah Heavy Attack - Multi-threading dilancarkan, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner diganti dengan Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive. Lucy mendapat seluruh efek Resonance Liberation - Netrunner, dan pengali DMG Override meningkat besar.
Setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, atau saat Lucy keluar dari state Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive diganti dengan Resonance Liberation - Netrunner.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.

attributes.name: Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive: Override DMG

description.en:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 stacks of Optical Illusion. Max 1 stacks by default.
Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 stacks of Optical Illusion. This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 0.5s.
description.id:
Saat Lucy menjadi Resonator aktif dalam tim, jika ia tidak menerima damage selama 8 dtk, ia mendapat 1 stack Optical Illusion. Maksimum 1 stack secara default.
Optical Illusion: Saat diserang, kurangi DMG serangan tersebut sebesar 100%. Jika Lucy terkena serangan atau terlempar, ia langsung pulih dan memicu Dodge yang berhasil jika berada di darat. Setelah efek ini terpicu, hapus 1 stack Optical Illusion. Efek ini dapat dipicu hingga 1 kali setiap 0,5 dtk.

description.en:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock damages an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

Network Backdoor

Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain Network Backdoor, and any existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid.
description.id:
Saat Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, atau Resonance Skill - Deadlock memberikan damage kepada musuh Overlord Class atau Calamity Class, Lucy memberikan Botnet Mark pada mereka selama 2 mnt. Selama Botnet Mark aktif, saat Resonator dalam tim mengalahkan target tersebut dengan damage langsung, Lucy mendapat efek Network Backdoor. Jika Rebecca ada dalam tim, ia mendapat efek yang sama.

Network Backdoor

Memberikan 10% All DMG Amplification dan 10% pengali Hack DMG tambahan. Efek ini berlangsung selama 2 mnt dan bertumpuk hingga 2 kali. Pada 2 stack, menambah All DMG Amplification sebesar 5% dan pengali Hack DMG sebesar 5%. Saat Lucy tumbang, ia tidak dapat lagi mendapat Network Backdoor, dan efek Network Backdoor yang ada menjadi tidak berlaku.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and granting Resonators in the team Involuntary Sharing, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for 25s. Additionally, Involuntary Sharing is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for 4s.
If Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
If Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
After casting this skill, the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 points of TCP.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG dan memberikan Involuntary Sharing kepada Resonator dalam tim, sehingga mereka dapat melihat target di balik rintangan selama 25 dtk. Selain itu, Involuntary Sharing ditingkatkan pada Rebecca, sehingga ia dapat mengunci target di balik rintangan. Jika turret Rebecca ada di lapangan, efek Overload-nya aktif, meningkatkan DMG yang diberikannya selama 4 dtk.
Jika Lucy tidak dalam Algorithm Compaction setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Jika Lucy dalam Algorithm Compaction setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Tahap 2.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference berikutnya juga memberikan 20 poin TCP.

description.en:
Cloud Portal

When not in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains TCP upon hitting a target. At 100 points of TCP, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive clears all TCP.

Algorithm Compaction

After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains 1 stacks of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 65% for 8s.
While in Algorithm Compaction, casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock again will not grant SQL and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains Root Access upon hitting a target with attacks including Basic Attack - Thread Shredding and Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Reaching 100 points of Root Access replaces Heavy Attack - Single Threading with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack - Dual Threading to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by 270% and remove SQL.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy does not have SQL, she loses 20% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below 1%, no HP is consumed.
After casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
Lucy exits the the Algorithm Compaction state after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is not followed up by one of these skills: Normal Attack - Locked Thread, Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach, Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, and Tune Break - Data Crash.

Hack Response - Data Crash

Lucy deals Spectro DMG to a target inflicted with Hack - Interfered and applies the same target with Data Crash, considered Hack DMG.
Data Crash: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for 0.5s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

TCP

Lucy holds up to 100 points of TCP.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference.
After casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, casting the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 points of TCP.

Root Access

Lucy holds up to 100 points of Root Access.
Lucy gains Root Access when she deals damage through Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, and Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
description.id:
Cloud Portal

Saat tidak dalam Algorithm Compaction, Lucy mendapat TCP saat mengenai target. Pada 100 poin TCP, Resonance Skill - Payload dan Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference diganti dengan Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Netrunner atau Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive menghapus seluruh TCP.

Algorithm Compaction

Setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy memasuki Algorithm Compaction dan mendapat 1 stack SQL. Basic Attack-nya diganti dengan Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, dan Heavy Attack diganti dengan Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Spectro DMG Bonus Lucy meningkat sebesar 65% selama 8 dtk.
Saat dalam Algorithm Compaction, melancarkan Resonance Skill - Deadlock lagi tidak akan memberikan SQL dan Spectro DMG Bonus secara berulang.
Saat dalam Algorithm Compaction, Lucy mendapat Root Access saat mengenai target dengan serangan termasuk Basic Attack - Thread Shredding dan Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Mencapai 100 poin Root Access mengganti Heavy Attack - Single Threading dengan Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack - Dual Threading untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, jika Lucy memiliki SQL, tingkatkan pengali DMG serangan ini sebesar 270% dan hapus SQL.
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, jika Lucy tidak memiliki SQL, ia kehilangan 20% HP saat ini. Jika HP Lucy di bawah 1%, tidak ada HP yang dikonsumsi.
Setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner diganti dengan Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
Lucy keluar dari state Algorithm Compaction setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Netrunner atau Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, atau Heavy Attack - Multi-threading tidak diikuti salah satu skill berikut: Normal Attack - Locked Thread, Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach, Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, dan Tune Break - Data Crash.

Hack Response - Data Crash

Lucy memberikan Spectro DMG kepada target yang terkena Hack - Interfered dan memberikan Data Crash pada target yang sama, dianggap sebagai Hack DMG.
Data Crash: Setelah target memberikan damage, Stagnate target selama 0,5 dtk. Data Crash dihapus setelah efek ini terpicu.

TCP

Lucy dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin TCP.
Lucy mendapat TCP saat memberikan damage melalui Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter.
Lucy mendapat TCP saat memberikan damage melalui Resonance Skill - Payload dan Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference.
Setelah melancarkan Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, melancarkan Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference berikutnya juga memberikan 20 poin TCP.

Root Access

Lucy dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Root Access.
Lucy mendapat Root Access saat memberikan damage melalui Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, dan Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en:
The incoming Resonator gains 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Grants all Resonators in the team Countermeasure Program for 25s.
While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts Hack - Shifting, that Resonator gains 20% All DMG Amplification.
While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them 30% DMG Reduction for 3s and Stagnates their attacker for 1s. This effect can only trigger up to 1 time while Countermeasure Program is active. Obtaining Countermeasure Program again resets the effective charge.
When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the Countermeasure Program early.
description.id:
Resonator yang masuk mendapat 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.
Memberikan Countermeasure Program kepada seluruh Resonator dalam tim selama 25 dtk.
Selama efek aktif, saat Resonator aktif dalam tim selain Lucy memberikan Hack - Shifting, Resonator tersebut mendapat 20% All DMG Amplification.
Selama efek aktif, saat Resonator dalam tim selain Lucy diserang, Lucy memberi mereka 30% DMG Reduction selama 3 dtk dan Stagnate penyerang mereka selama 1 dtk. Efek ini hanya dapat terpicu hingga 1 kali selama Countermeasure Program aktif. Mendapat Countermeasure Program lagi me-reset jumlah kesempatan efektif.
Saat All DMG Amplification berlaku, berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri Countermeasure Program lebih awal.

description.en:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Lucy can cast Tune Break on the target.
Responding to Hack - Interfered: when Resonators in the team trigger Tune Break on the target and cause them to be affected by Hack - Interfered, Lucy applies Hack Response - Data Crash on the target. Each target can be inflicted with this effect up to 1 times every 8s.
description.id:
Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Lucy dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.
Merespons Hack - Interfered: saat Resonator dalam tim memicu Tune Break pada target dan membuatnya terkena Hack - Interfered, Lucy memberikan Hack Response - Data Crash pada target. Setiap target dapat terkena efek ini hingga 1 kali setiap 8 dtk.

sequences.name: The Moon, a Ticket, and a Dream

description.en:
Lucy is now immune to interruptions during Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Inteference, Heavy Attack - Dual Threading, and Heavy Attack - Multi-Threading
Casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination increases ATK by 20% for 14s.
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target affected by Spoofing Program with direct damage, Lucy records the effect triggered and activates the corresponding Quick Action on that Resonator for 6s. The record expires when Lucy is knocked out.
Quick Action: When activated, inflict the recorded Spoofing Program effects on targets within a certain distance from the active Resonator in the team, effective once only on each target.
The following Spoofing Program effects can be recorded: Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction, Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol, Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement, Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch, and Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis. When applying Spoofing Program effects via Quick Action, only the continuous status effects are applied.
